reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about lattice structure, dislocation behavior, and property enhancement, but cites no prior evidence whatsoever to support any of these premises.
premises: High-entropy alloys form a stable, disordered lattice structure
This disordered lattice inhibits dislocation movement
Inhibition of dislocation movement enhances both strength and ductility
This mechanism operates across wide strain rates (10^-3 to 10^3 s^-1) and temperatures (RT to 800°C)
